svg.title: ORBIT architecture
svg.desc: People and API clients talk to orbit-api, the control plane, which keeps all state in PostgreSQL. Workers in the execution plane pull runs from the API with a scoped token, run a harness such as OpenCode or Pi, and pass every tool call through a policy-checking tool broker before it reaches an outside system.
svg.text: The control plane decides and remembers. Workers do the work, and every tool call passes a policy check.
Scripts, CI and your own tools
REST /api/v1 · live events (SSE) · OIDC or API token
the HTTP API and the background loops
Workers hold only a scoped, revocable token
a process, a container or a Kubernetes pod
